        - button "Sarah Jackson":

        - generic: Pretty sure this is one from the maranta family which do flop and drape not grow upwards. Not the exact one but I have seen the one you have. Water with rainwater and from the bottom not the top. Small ish pot they don’t like space. And humidity is an absolute must. I keep mine over 60% for this one. Each “prayer plant” I find has different humidity needs but this one is one of the less fussy ones I’ve found.
